How will this game be different?

Personally

I'm super intrigued to see what this game has in store for me. I do like to think I'm a fairly adaptable competitor when it comes to survivor. My philosophy is that not one game of survivor is the same, and often it's about the people within it that alter the direction of thinking required to be successful. So the goal is to get a read once the game starts, evaluate and adjust accordingly. Maybe I'll be more visible this game? I do think there's a non zero chance being a fallen angel comes with associated threat level, which would be a change from last season for me.
